newsitem.title: USA: American Medical, STAT Healthcare to merge.
newsitem.headline: American Medical, STAT Healthcare to merge.

text.p: American Medical Response Inc and STAT Healthcare Inc said Thursday they have agreed to merge in a deal valued at about $145 million.

Each share of STAT common stock will be converted into 0.25 shares of American Medical common for the merger, the companies said. American Medical said it will issue about 4 million shares based upon the exchange ratio.
STAT stockholders representing about 60 percent of outstanding shares have agreed to vote in favor of the merger, which is expected to close by year-end, the companies said.
STAT, based in Houston, Texas, provides emergency physician and disease management services.
American Medical provids emergency and non-emergency ambulance services in 28 states. The company said it plans to continue acquiring ambulance providers and complementary health care providers.
It said its merger with STAT will be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests.
